content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RITES Manager-PAPIS Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 04-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RITES to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RITES Manager-PAPIS recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the RITES Manager-PAPIS recruitment is 04-10-2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the Manager-PAPIS post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a full-time Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Electronics & Telecommunication or an equivalent qualification to be eligible for the Manager-PAPIS position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Manager-PAPIS position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Manager-PAPIS post is 40 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Manager-PAPIS role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Manager-PAPIS post will receive a salary in the pay scale of INR 50,000-1,60,000, along with various allowances.

faq.question: Q5. How is the selection process conducted for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the RITES Manager-PAPIS recruitment involves a Document Scrutiny/verification process followed by an Interview. Candidates must clear both stages to be considered.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the RITES Manager-PAPIS recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the available information, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for the RITES Manager-PAPIS recruitment. Candidates should verify this on the official website.

faq.question: Q7. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for a contract-based position. The selected candidate will be appointed on a contract basis for the Manager-PAPIS role.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Manager-PAPIS post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Manager-PAPIS post in this RITES recruitment drive. This is a single opening for the specified role.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification and the online application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article. You can also visit the RITES official website for more details.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job location for this recruitment is Gurgaon, Haryana, with the recruitment being applicable across India. The RITES office is located at 122001.
